content: Ling et al. ling2012fine proposed the first system for FgNER, where they used 112 overlapping labels with a linear classifier perceptron for multi-label classification. Yosef et al. spaniol2012hyena used multiple binary SVM classifiers to assign entities to a set of 505 types. Gillick et al. gillick2014context introduced context dependent FgNER and proposed a set of heuristics for pruning labels that might not be relevant given the local context of the entity. Yogatama et al. yogatama2015embedding proposed an embedding based model where user-defined features and labels were embedded into a low dimensional feature space to facilitate information sharing among labels.
